summary: Created as MPI-553 phase 1, replacing MPI-506 which closed `complete` when SeedVR2 was dropped and took the unbuilt dropdown mechanism with it. Verified in code: pluginsRegistry.js has one plugin (image-describer) and PluginDef has no dropdown/slot field, and MpiToolOptionsUpscale builds its list from None + assets with no plugin awareness - so the mechanism does not exist and MPI-507 is blocked on a hole. Ships the LTX Video upscaler (Fabio's name, verbatim) as a plugin in the VIDEO upscale dropdown with a prompt box and two 0-1 sliders whose mapping is hidden: denoise -> sigmas 0.50-0.85 default UI 0.5, prompt strength -> cfg 1-3 default UI 0. All four values are Fabio's from MPI-568 and are not to be re-derived. Also owes audio pass-through (unbuilt - the bench drops it) and an in-app VRAM measurement, since the bench peaks at 97% of a 16 GB card under NORMAL_VRAM/int8 while the app runs --lowvram/bf16.

Amended on three corrections from Fabio. (1) This does NOT build a dropdown - the History workspace Upscale tool already has one (MpiToolOptionsUpscale, shared by image and video via `kind`) and this card adds ONE ENTRY plus the controls behind it. (2) The mechanism moved OUT to MPI-580, so this card is now phase 1b and BLOCKED ON MPI-580 - a mechanism must not ride on a product card, which is exactly how MPI-506 killed it last time. (3) MPI-557 adopts this upscaler, so the plugin is a Flow requirement and has a second consumer before it ships. Also recorded: there is NOTHING TO DOWNLOAD - ltx23-spatial-upscaler is already an assetDep, already on R2 and already in both LTX tiers' dependencies, so an LTX user is satisfied for free, exactly as Fabio predicted.
